evals_reused_note: Origin ships 4 dense, high-quality real-incident-derived evals (two in Chinese, testing methodology rigor: evidence-over-assumption, falsifiable hypotheses, counter-review, domain generalization beyond networking to a DB pool-exhaustion case). Field names reshaped from 'name'/'expected_behavior' to this project's 'expected_output'/'expectations' schema; content kept as-is including the Chinese prompts, since non-English coverage is itself a real gap this project's own security-scan discipline calls out. Extended to 8 with 4 additional English-language cases.
live_dependency_note: All cases are text-based investigative-methodology reasoning tasks graded on the quality of the investigation plan proposed, not on live network access to any real system.
